confirm_name_hint: This is the name printed on your certificate.
dir_found: Opening directions from your current location.
dir_denied: Location access was blocked, so the route starts from Google's estimate. You can allow location for this site in your browser settings.
dir_failed: We couldn't get your exact location, so the route starts from Google's estimate.
err_email: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
err_phone: Enter a valid phone number, like 0750 123 4567 or +964 750 123 4567.
err_student_id: Upload a photo of your student ID to continue.
err_student_id_type: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
err_student_id_size: The student ID photo must be 8 MB or smaller.
err_terms: Please confirm this to complete your registration.
success_text: Your {method} payment link will be sent to {email}. After payment is confirmed, your ticket will be sent to {email}. Keep your reference number for any questions.
spf_ok_text: We have your request and will reply to {email}. Keep your reference for any question.
pg_soon_title: The full program will be announced soon
pg_soon_text: Sessions, topics, speakers and rooms for both days are being finalised. Check back soon.
reg_closed_text: Online registration is not open yet. Follow iSmile for the opening date, or write to us.
reg_full_text: All places have been taken. Thank you for your interest.
reg_ok_later_text: We could not open the payment page just now. Your registration is saved and we have emailed a payment link to {email}. You do not need to register again.
err_server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
err_busy: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
err_lunch_full: One of the lunch days you chose is now full. Please choose again.
reg_closed: Registration is closed at the moment.
pm_checking_text: This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.
pm_slow_text: Your bank is taking longer than usual. You can close this page: we email your ticket as soon as the payment is confirmed.
pm_paid_title: You are in! Welcome to iSmile 2026
pm_paid_text: Your ticket has been emailed to you. You can also show this QR code at the entrance.
pm_failed_text: No money was taken for this attempt. Your registration is saved: you can try again now.
pm_unpaid_text: Your registration is saved but not paid yet. An unpaid registration does not hold a place.
pm_cancelled_text: If you think this is a mistake, write to ismile@italk.krd with your reference.
pm_link_text: It may have expired or been replaced by a newer one. Use the link in your newest email, or write to ismile@italk.krd.
pm_start_failed: We could not open the payment page just now. Your registration is saved and we have emailed you a payment link.
photo_not_needed: There is nothing to upload for this registration right now.
link: This link does not work. Use the link in your newest email.
pm_expired_text: The payment was not made in time, so you are not registered and nothing was kept. Please fill in the form again.
pm_lunch_title: That lunch day is now full
pm_lunch_text: The lunch you chose was taken while you were registering, so nothing was charged and you are not registered yet. Please register again without that lunch day.
bm_intro: Explore the 44 numbered booths. Reserved spaces appear in red on the map and in the table.
bm_hint: Select a booth to see its size and availability. On a phone, scroll across the map to explore.
bm_select: Select a numbered booth on the map or in the table.
bm_table_caption: Booth tiers, numbers, sizes and live bookings
bm_size_note: W = width · L = length · Sizes in meters. Booths 1, 6 and 24: width only.
bm_privacy: Bookings update automatically. Company names and contact details are private.
spf_kind_spon_d: Platinum, Gold, Silver or Bronze: logo placement and visibility.
spf_kind_tiers_d: Platinum, Gold, Silver or Bronze: logo placement and visibility.
bm_detail_hint: The matching number is highlighted in both the map and the table.
bm_table_hint: Compare the tiers, sizes and bookings. Select a booth number to find it on the map.
